messages.author: b7c2064c737945ab
messages.subject: dev='tiff' gives latex error
parts:
I found dev='tiff' gives error when generating pdf.
pdflatex gives the following error:
C:/Users/ptong1/Desktop/LocalErrorReport/toy.tex:408: LaTeX Error:
File `figure
/tiffGraphics' not found.

How can I fix this?
Thanks very much.

Nicky

Here is the sample Rnw file to reproduce the error:

\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}

Using tiff doesn't work: (similar for bmp).
<<tiffGraphics, dev='tiff'>>=
plot(1:3, main='tiff')
@


\end{document}

parts:
My guess is LaTeX does not support TIFF or BMP at all. Given that we
have PDF and PNG, what is the point of using TIFF and BMP? :)

Regards,

messages.author: b7c2064c737945ab
messages.subject: Re: dev='tiff' gives latex error
parts:
Mostly I use PDF. However, for genomics studies with 100K points on
the graph, pdf is huge and makes it difficult to navigate the pdf
report from Rnw. Using png is kind of blurring. Thus, I tend to like
tiff format. If there is no simple fix within knitr, I'd adjust the
resolution for png.

Best,
Nicky

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: dev='tiff' gives latex error

images, and then how to compile the tex file is purely a LaTeX
problem.
